title: Persona tag on every gate check
description: User story under REQ-174. Every entry in stages[].checks[] carries an owning persona (productOwner | engineer) declared in code next to the check, so readiness consumers (the CLI, the viewer tab, delivery-stream artefacts) can route a failing check to whoever is actually blocked.
asA: an engineer reading a readiness report
iWant: every failing check to say whose question it is
soThat: product-owner questions reach the product owner and engineering gaps stay with me

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given any tree, when readiness is computed, then every entry in stages[].checks[] carries persona equal to 'productOwner' or 'engineer' and a non-empty question string.
[happy] Given the D1 checks, when readiness is computed, then brief:sinceFreeze, brief:kinds, brief:openQuestions and brief:profile carry persona 'productOwner'.

[happy] Given the D2 checks, when readiness is computed, then skeleton:resolvedBy and skeleton:reqIntent carry persona 'productOwner' and skeleton:reqShape, skeleton:tadPersistence and skeleton:deployAdr carry persona 'engineer'.

[happy] Given the D4 and D7 checks, when readiness is computed, then stories:reqHasUs and decisions:wellFormed carry persona 'productOwner' and stories:usFloors and decisions:allAnswered carry persona 'engineer'.
[happy] Given the D3, D5, D6 and D8 checks, when readiness is computed, then every check carries persona 'engineer'.
[must-not] Given any check, when readiness is computed, then no check carries a persona value other than 'productOwner' or 'engineer', and no failing item carries its own persona.
[failure] Given a notApplicable stage, when readiness is computed, then its stage:<D>:scope placeholder check carries the stage's STAGE_FALLBACK_PERSONA and ok true.
